inlines.v: FO'RUM, noun [Latin See Fair.] 1. In Rome, a public place, where causes were judicially tried, and orations delivered to the people; also, a market place. Hence, 2. A tribunal; a court; any assembly empowered to hear and decide causes; also, jurisdiction.
